domain_notes: For the boost of rapidity b the invariant interval of the closed geodesic through p and boost^n(p) is exactly 2 (cosh(n b) - 1) (t^2 - x^2). It is negative -- a CTC -- precisely where x^2 > t^2, which is the image of the T > 0 region of the Misner chart. This reproduces M12 from a completely different representation.
